name: Longer Nano 6W
tagline: Longer's entry portable : compact diode for small projects
tldr: Longer Nano 6W is a compact portable engraver for small gifts and learning. Pairs with Longer's accessory ecosystem. Upgrade to Nano Pro 12W if you need real cutting speed.
mainObjective: Detailed engraving on organics and coated metal : occasional thin cuts only

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Longer's entry portable : compact diode for small projects
Open-frame layout : laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Work area 130 × 130 mm (approx.) on this chassis
6W on Longer Nano: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Reference engrave job on this module: ~18–28 min
Reference cut job on this module: ~9–15 min
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 4 mm basswood class) : not thick production plywood
Higher modules in this line (12W) add cut speed and depth
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 4 mm+ stock all day
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 6W module on Longer Nano. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Optimize for engraving: lower DPI on photos, higher scan speed on line art after test burns. Air assist still helps clarity. Compare benchmark times on the next tier before assuming you need more power.
primaryUse: Engraving-first desktop diode for makers who prioritize mark quality over cut speed
